We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals? But need number of methyl groups, not signals. Could be overlapping. Might need HSQC to map.

We have no SMILES. So we need to measure proton NMR. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no args). Let's call it.
